citations.excerpt: If you use the Prism llama.cpp server for one request at a time on a GPU with limited VRAM, add -np 1 to your existing llama-server command. This limits the server to one request slot. In automatic mode, the server can start with four slots that share a unified KV cache.

citations.excerpt: A community report on an RTX 3080 10 GB measured about 9.5 GB of total GPU memory use before adding -np 1 and about 7.8 GB afterward, including desktop usage. Memory use depends on your build, context size, and other settings.

citations.excerpt: We added a Known issues note to the model card recommending -np 1 for single-user servers on GPUs with limited VRAM. The four automatic slots share a unified KV cache.
